items.summary: The San Francisco Controller's Office annual report on nonprofit monitoring for fiscal year 2024-25 lists Young Community Developers among 14 nonprofits it designated to Tier 2 under the Citywide Nonprofit Corrective Action Policy, marked "Newly designated," and lists six fiscal findings for the organization with a final status of findings not in conformance. The report says a Tier 2 designation gives notice of increased risk to public funds and client services due to serious fiscal or programmatic concerns. The San Francisco Chronicle editorial board wrote that the organization was placed on Tier 2 status under Brookter, its former CEO.
